title: Orchestras
description: Orchestras' own websites: the primary source for each orchestra's seasons, programs, artists, and self-description. One source per orchestra. Started with Berkeley Symphony; peer orchestras are added when the peer-seasons work starts.
readme: Authoritative Source Registry. Source profiles under sources/, one directory per source; resolve objects through this manifest's sections and source index, never by guessing paths. Access claims are verified against stored probe evidence (see rules_note); credentials are referenced by name and never stored in tracked files.
